about_short_description.short_description: Weave Robotics is a Robotics Engineering firm offering Personal robots for the home.

product.name: Isaac
product.description: A personal home robot designed to tidy rooms, fold laundry, organize belongings, care for pets and plants, find and fetch objects, and respond to voice, text, and scheduled commands.

product.name: Remote Op
product.description: A remote-teleoperation service in which Weave specialists operate an Isaac to complete household tasks that the robot cannot yet perform autonomously.
